entities.name: High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy is a Vice-President of the European Commission responsible for foreign affairs, a role that emerged in the 1990s as a key part of European integration. This position oversees the European Union's Common Foreign and Security Policy, and is responsible for coordinating EU foreign policy and security efforts. The High Representative plays a crucial role in shaping the EU's foreign policy agenda and in promoting the EU's interests and values on the global stage.

The High Representative has been instrumental in shaping the EU's foreign policy response to major global challenges, including the Arab Spring, the European migrant crisis, and the conflict in Ukraine. This role has also been critical in promoting the EU's global influence and in fostering international cooperation on issues such as climate change, human rights, and non-proliferation.

The legacy of the High Representative can be seen in the EU's increased global influence and its ability to shape the international agenda on key issues. This role has also contributed to the development of the EU's Common Security and Defence Policy, which has enabled the EU to take on a more prominent role in international peacekeeping and crisis management.

As the EU continues to evolve and play a more significant role on the global stage, the High Representative will remain a key figure in shaping the EU's foreign policy and promoting its values and interests around the world.
